About Coach K

Kevin
Richardson

I'm Coach K — Kevin Richardson — a USGTF certified golf teaching professional dedicated to transforming your game from the ground up. My coaching philosophy is simple: every golfer has untapped potential, and it's my job to unlock it.

From total beginners picking up a club for the first time, to experienced players looking to eliminate that stubborn slice or sharpen their short game, I tailor every session to you. No cookie-cutter drills. No one-size-fits-all advice.

Whether you're 8 or 80+, chasing birdies or just trying to break 100 — I'll meet you where you are and get you where you want to go.

🏅
USGTF Certified
United States Golf Teachers Federation

What I Offer

Lessons & Programs

🌱
Beginner Lessons

Never picked up a club? No problem. We start with the fundamentals — grip, stance, posture — and build a rock-solid foundation you'll rely on for life.

Start Here →
🏌️
Swing Improvement

Video analysis, biomechanical coaching, and targeted drills to reshape your swing and add distance, consistency, and control to every shot.

Transform Your Swing →
🎯
Short Game & Putting

Scoring happens inside 100 yards. Master chipping, pitching, bunker play, and the flat stick with drills that translate directly to lower scores.

Drop Strokes Fast →
⭐
Junior Golf

A fun, structured environment for young players to fall in love with the game. Building skills, sportsmanship, and confidence on the course.

For Future Stars →

Real Results

Coach K's teaching style is clear and patient, which made it easy for me to understand the fundamentals and apply the techniques on my own. Each lesson was tailored to my skill level and built naturally on what I learned in previous lessons. I always left with a better understanding of my swing and practical things to work on between sessions. I highly recommend Coach K to anyone looking to start golf or improve their game in a supportive and positive learning environment!

— Kathleen D. · Beginner Lessons
"
★★★★★

Coach K was incredible in helping both my mom and I go from complete beginners to actually being able to play with confidence. When we started, we truly had zero experience, but Coach K broke everything down in a way that made it simple, fun, and encouraging. What I appreciated most was the patience and the ability to meet us exactly where we were. Every lesson built our skills step by step, and before we knew it, we were rallying and actually enjoying the game instead of feeling intimidated by it. If you're starting from scratch or just need someone who can make learning feel approachable, I can't recommend Coach K enough.
